01 / SOFTWARE + AI CASE STUDY

StockLens.

A full-stack financial interface combining portfolio workflows, Finnhub market data, and Google Gemini analysis.

Next.js 16TypeScriptMongoDB / MongooseGeminiFinnhubBetter AuthRedisInngest
THE PROBLEM

Portfolio context,
not just a quote screen.

StockLens is designed around tracking holdings and watchlists, checking market information, and generating portfolio-oriented analysis. The repository implements sign-up/sign-in flows, portfolio transactions, watchlist interaction, stock pages, and an analysis action.

IMPLEMENTED

Product workflow

Holdings, transaction history, portfolio summary, watchlist, stock details, and TradingView widgets are represented in the app structure.

IMPLEMENTED

External systems

Finnhub actions provide market-data access. Gemini integration supports portfolio analysis. Nodemailer, Inngest and Redis modules are present.

DESIGN CHOICE

AI in context

Generative output is positioned beside portfolio data, giving the model a meaningful task instead of a detached chat surface.

NEXT ITERATION

Decision safety

Add explicit investment-risk framing, evaluation datasets, and observability around model quality before treating generated analysis as a decision aid.
